subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.

It is a general belief that the female ostrich __guard the nest at night.__

options.text: is guarding the nest at night
does guard the nest in night

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"guard"** means to keep watch over something to protect or control it. (रक्षा करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The soldiers guard the border diligently.
 
 
 
• **"Guards"** is the simple present tense of "guard" and is used to indicate a habitual action or a general truth. (रक्षा करता है)
 
 
• **Example:** The security guard guards the building every night.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: is guarding the nest at night** (रात को घोंसले की रक्षा कर रही है): This is in the present continuous tense, which indicates an action that is currently ongoing.

 
 
• **Example:** She is guarding the nest at night.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: does guard the nest in night** (रात में घोंसले की रक्षा करती है): This is an emphatic form of the simple present tense, but "in night" is incorrect; it should be "at night."
 
 
• **Example:** She does guard the nest at night.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: guarded the nest at night** (रात को घोंसले की रक्षा की): This is in the past tense, indicating an action that happened in the past.
 
 
• **Example:** She guarded the nest at night last year.

The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **severe**.
